title: Cellmate Secrets
description:
S01 E02 — Drew Peterson
In 2007, Drew Peterson was charged with murdering Kathleen, his third wife; new interviews with Drew's girlfriend, Nicole Speakman.

title: A Model Murder
description: Model Kara Woods seeks help from a security influencer after she starts to get disturbing messages from one of her fans. Things seem fine for a while -- until her stalker begins to show up in person.

title: Deadly Influencer
description: A young woman commits murder to keep her classmates' social media careers under her thumb. After killing a popular friend, she turns her sights on a new girl, but the girl's mother suspects the truth and will fight to protect her daughter.

title: Dancing With a Murderer
description: A woman gets drawn back into a web of deceit, obsession, and a killer's ruthless game.

title: Buried in Barstow
description: A single mother and former hit woman's dark past keeps coming back to haunt her, despite her desire for a quiet life.

title: Buried Alive & Survived
description: Alicia's ex-husband, Victor is released from prison. Victor traps Alicia underground and buries her alive. Alicia pushes down the panic and manages to claw her way of out of her grave. Now freed, she searches desperately for her son.

title: The Body in the Locker
description: Amy gets the shock of her life when she discovers her late father's storage locker contains the body of a woman. As the truth starts to emerge, she learns that the killer is still out there and she could be the next victim.

title: Cellmate Secrets
description:
S01 E03 — Joyce Mitchell
A former prison staffer named Joyce Mitchell helped two convicts escape from Dannemora prison in N.Y.; Erik Jensen reveals the tactics that inmates used to convince Joyce to help them escape.

title: A Murder to Remember
description: A woman finds herself in grave danger when her husband dies in the wilderness, and she accepts help from a seemingly friendly camper.

title: It's Beginning to Look a Lot Like Murder
description: After inheriting an old house from her beloved aunt, Diana Hart finds clues that suggest her aunt was murdered and the culprit might be her handsome companion.

title: Match, Meet, Murder
description: Diving into the world of dating apps, a lingerie designer meets a handsome stranger who's smart, successful, and a former contestant on a dating show. However, she soon learns that the show wasn't the only secret he failed to mention in his profile.

title: Cellmate Secrets
description:
S01 E06 — Shayna Hubers
Shayna Hubers shot and killed her boyfriend, Ryan Poston; now Holly Nivens details how Shayna manipulated her into believing it was self-defense; Cecily Miller details Shayna's behavior after her arrest; Carissa details how Ryan wanted out.

title: The Grim Sleeper
description: Journalist Christine Pelisek helps law enforcement investigate the alleged serial killer known as the Grim Sleeper.

title: The Hunt for the I-5 Killer
description: A detective (John Corbett) searches for a murderer who cruises the highways of California, Washington and Oregon.

title: Manson's Lost Girls
description: In the summer of 1969, Linda Kasabian (MacKenzie Mauzy) traveled to a California ranch where cult leader Charles Manson (Jeff Ward) ordered his followers to commit heinous crimes.

title: Beyond the Headlines: The Watts Family Tragedy
description: A deeper look into the circumstances surrounding the Chris Watts murder case includes never-before-seen footage and new interviews with Tammy Lee, the agent with the Colorado Bureau of Investigation who elicited Watt's confession.
